Setting: Privileged Access Protection In Place (Compliant Device Or Phishing-Resistant Auth Strength For Admins)
Recommendation: Ensure at least one hardening control protects privileged role sign-ins: require a compliant device, or require a phishing-resistant authentication strength for admin roles via Conditional Access. A Privileged Access Workstation (PAW) model or equivalent out-of-band control also satisfies this intent even though it isn't visible to this assessment - treat this finding as a starting point for that conversation, not a mandate for one specific implementation.
